purpose: Convert heterogeneous company/environment evidence into a compact, source-traceable review brief for environmental-management study. The system may propose review topics, but must not make unsupported causal or performance judgments.

notes.company_name: Natural-language company name supplied by the user.
notes.analysis_period: Requested multi-year window. Source-native disclosure cadence is preserved; missing annual values are never fabricated.
notes.requested_scope: Optional business-unit/site scope such as Samsung Electronics DS. Raw evidence remains preserved outside the scoped review view.

target_brief_pages.overflow_policy: Move detail to workbook/source archive rather than expanding the main brief.

brief_sections.title: Company & Business Context
brief_sections.goal: Provide only the business facts needed to interpret environmental evidence.
contents: major domestic sites and site roles
high-level process flow when publicly supportable
recent capacity/expansion/business changes relevant to environmental context

brief_sections.title: Environmental Management Overview
brief_sections.goal: Summarize cross-media management systems separately from individual environmental media.
contents: permit or integrated-permit status when public

brief_sections.title: Environmental Media Snapshot
brief_sections.goal: Give broad but shallow coverage of each relevant environmental domain before selecting deeper topics.
brief_sections.missing_data_policy: Explicitly mark public evidence as not found/not applicable/insufficient rather than inventing a filled section.

brief_sections.title: Multi-year Signals
brief_sections.goal: Surface only changes that alter what the user should inspect next.

brief_sections.title: Priority Review Topics
brief_sections.goal: Propose 3-5 study priorities using explicit evidence, not an opaque score.
brief_sections.rule: A topic must show its evidence dimensions and limitations. Do not force five topics if evidence is weak.

brief_sections.title: BAT / Technical / Management Context
brief_sections.goal: Provide a technical starting point for the user's further study without guessing site-specific technology.

brief_sections.title: Questions for Further Review
brief_sections.goal: Turn unresolved evidence into concrete questions about process, equipment, operating conditions, production scale, legal requirements, or treatment performance.

brief_sections.title: Evidence Index
brief_sections.goal: Allow every material fact and AI review statement to be traced back to source, year, scope, and evidence location.

AI_REVIEW.definition: AI-proposed relationship, prioritization, or review suggestion built from one or more facts.
AI_REVIEW.human_role: User decides whether to adopt, hold, or reject the review suggestion.

TO_VERIFY.definition: Information needed before a stronger interpretation can be made.

hard_boundaries: No automatic statement that investment caused an emission change.
No automatic rating that environmental management improved or worsened from absolute emissions alone.
No claim that a company applies a BAT unless company-specific public evidence supports it.
No forced comparison across incompatible definitions, scopes, units, or regulatory measurement transitions.
Keep raw/source evidence available even when the review scope is narrower.
